title: Luke catena: infancy and forerunner
english: Catena fragments on Luke gather notes on the infancy and John’s role so that the forerunner prepares a people for the Lord and Mary’s word is treasured [[in her heart >> Bible:Luke 2:19]].
translator_notes: Copy-text: First1KGreek / OpenGreekAndLatin Origen catena & scholia TEI (tlg2042.tlg006/017/077/078). PD.

Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
